name: Codex
reason: ChatGPT is my personal preference for development. For the way I work, the usage allowance feels generous and the connectivity is among the best. Most importantly, I like the interface. That is why I use Codex for development. Your actual limits depend on your plan and the work you give it.

referral.disclosure: Using this referral link supports me. It is optional and is not required to use Starter Pack.

name: Claude Code
reason: Claude Code is the development harness for working on your project. I see it as a strong enterprise-oriented option; compare paid-plan costs for heavier use. The Claude phone companion is a separate role, covered below.

name: Cursor
reason: I would point you toward Cursor if you are serious about getting into development as a whole, or interested in agents that work on longer tasks. It puts the editor and project workflow at the center. Check which cloud and long-running capabilities your plan includes.

name: Google Antigravity
reason: Antigravity is a Phase 2 computer option, especially if you already use Google services. Check what your plan includes. Gemini is not a supported companion for this pack.

name: Your companion agent on your phone
reason:
Required: a signed-in companion on your phone, separate from your development harness.

Supported: ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor. Gemini is not supported; other companions may vary.

For Antigravity users or those with untested or unsupported harnesses, free Claude Sonnet is a Phase 1 workaround. Sonnet 4.6 at Medium effort has been enough within the free allowance in my testing; use those settings when available.

name: GitHub
reason: Own durable project repositories and private progress.

name: GitHub Mobile
reason: Required in Phase 1. Sign into your GitHub account and confirm your profile opens.

name: Authenticator app
reason: Required in Phase 1, even when you usually use passkeys. I use Google Authenticator; an existing working authenticator counts.

name: Cloudflare
reason: Default deployment and domain platform in this workflow.

name: Neon
reason: Prepare relational-data access; create a database only when needed.

name: Google AI Studio
reason: One instant builder is required; existing Google access may be sufficient.

name: Lovable
reason: An alternative for the one required instant builder.

name: Base44
reason: An alternative for the one required instant builder.

name: Replit
reason: An alternative for the one required instant builder.

name: Vercel
reason: Alternate deployment option; check current plan suitability for your project.

name: Tailscale
reason: Phase 2 private networking; pair with a working interaction layer.
